allow: PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "LENGTH: $\($r.Content.Length\)"; $snippet = $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(3000, $r.Content.Length\)\); Write-Host "---FIRST 3000 CHARS---"; Write-Host $snippet; Write-Host "---CONTAINS main?---"; Write-Host \($r.Content -match "main-content"\); Write-Host "---CONTAINS loading-screen?---"; Write-Host \($r.Content -match "loading-screen"\); Write-Host "---CONTAINS ScrollProgress?---"; Write-Host \($r.Content -match "scroll-progress"\))

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "src\\app\\certificates" -Force 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Host "---DIR CHECK---"; if \(Test-Path "src\\app\\certificates"\) { \(Get-ChildItem "src\\app\\certificates" -Recurse | Select-Object FullName | Out-String\).Trim\(\); if \(-not \(Get-ChildItem "src\\app\\certificates" -Recurse\)\) { Write-Host "\(empty dir\)" } } else { Write-Host "no certificates dir" })
